workflow.title: Architectural Decision Record (ADR) Workflow
workflow.step: Triggered when choosing between competing database engines, message queues, state management paradigms, or boundary protocol changes.
Create docs/adr/NNNN-title.md using the standard format: Status (Proposed/Accepted/Superseded), Context, Decision, and Consequences.
Explicitly enumerate both positive consequences and negative trade-offs (e.g. increased operational complexity, learning curve).
Submit ADR via PR for consensus before writing production code that depends on the decision (ARCH-ADR-001).
